description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class 'CatalogTypeListEndpoint' for listing catalog types in a web application. It sets up routing, handles data retrieval via a repository, and maps data models to DTOs for API response.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving a list of catalog types, incorporating route registration and request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the GET API endpoint '/api/catalog-types' with the application, defining its behavior and response type.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Executes the logic to fetch catalog types from the repository, maps them to DTOs, and returns the result as an API response.
